paragraphs.source_en: What kind of people were they, who regarded a heroic suicide as the glory of a warrior? Those who kill are themselves forever killed; when will the endless cycle of vengeance cease? The heaps of corpses that had once filled Honnō-ji now filled Sakamoto Castle once more. The punishment Heaven visited upon the shallowness of human wisdom was cruel beyond measure! It is said that before his death, Samanosuke handed over to Hideyoshi all the celebrated treasures and precious utensils in the castle that he could not bear to burn.

paragraphs.source_en: Only after arranging every matter did Ieyasu enter the inner quarters to visit Lady Saigō. Chōshōmaru, born to O-Ai, was already seven, and the younger brother she later bore, named Fukumatsumaru, was now four.

units.source_zh: 家康安排完所有的事务之后，才走进内庭看望西乡局。

units.source_en: Chōshōmaru, born to O-Ai, was already seven, and the younger brother she later bore, named Fukumatsumaru, was now four.
units.source_zh: 阿爱所生的长松丸已经七岁，后来又生了一个弟弟，取名福松丸，也有四岁了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康安排完所有的事务之后，才走进内庭看望西乡局。阿爱所生的长松丸已经七岁，后来又生了一个弟弟，取名福松丸，也有四岁了。

paragraphs.source_en: “O-Ai, Akechi Hyūga-no-kami has been defeated.” As he spoke, Ieyasu signaled with his eyes to the attendant who had followed him and sent the man away. “Call the children here. It has been far too long since I held them.”

units.source_en: “O-Ai, Akechi Hyūga-no-kami has been defeated.”
units.source_zh: “阿爱，明智日向守已经战败了。”

units.source_en: As he spoke, Ieyasu signaled with his eyes to the attendant who had followed him and sent the man away.
units.source_zh: 家康说道，向跟着的侍从使了个眼色，把他支了出去。

units.source_en: “Call the children here. It has been far too long since I held them.”
units.source_zh: “把孩子们叫过来吧，好久没有抱抱他们了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “阿爱，明智日向守已经战败了。”家康说道，向跟着的侍从使了个眼色，把他支了出去。“把孩子们叫过来吧，好久没有抱抱他们了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu sat by the doorway, smiling as he admired the bright, open courtyard. A sea breeze blew in, and sunlight glittered across the lake.

units.source_en: Ieyasu sat by the doorway, smiling as he admired the bright, open courtyard.
units.source_zh: 家康坐在门前，笑眯眯地欣赏着敞亮的院子里的风景。

units.source_en: A sea breeze blew in, and sunlight glittered across the lake.
units.source_zh: 海风吹过来，湖面上波光粼粼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康坐在门前，笑眯眯地欣赏着敞亮的院子里的风景。海风吹过来，湖面上波光粼粼。
